name: saga-react-card-consumer-example
description: A synthetic React application that shows tool-result answers in SAGA's optional React FaithfulCard through the React stack's public exports on the page and the server exports of components and mcp, as one self-contained MCP Apps resource. It is not part of the npm workspace: scripts/build-react-card-consumer.ts installs the packed SDK packages into a clean copy of it and builds that.
